top_signals.title: AI Selloff Drags Emerging Stocks Down, Weighs on Currency Gauge
top_signals.summary: The deepening selloff in shares linked to artificial intelligence had emerging-market equities set for their worst day since July.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: US Army to stand up command for unmanned and autonomous warfare
top_signals.summary: An Oct. 1 memo directs the Army vice chief of staff to establish the U.S. Army Futures and Autonomous Systems Command, or FASCOM.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
